# selfdoc.unified

Orchestrates building a single documentation site from multiple constituent projects plus a docs-site's own cross-cutting content. Each constituent project is built using its own `selfdoc.json` configuration, while the docs-site's config provides unified orchestration via its `unified` section. The module handles merged navigation, cross-project search indexing, shared glossary terms, and combined sitemap and feed generation.

This is the entry point for monorepo documentation workflows where multiple packages or services share a single published docs site.
